_comment:
Curated catalog of skills + agents recommended for the user's typical work: graphics programming, Unreal Engine 5, AI/ML, MCP development. Each item points at a public GitHub source — the Library -> Catalog tab installs via library_install_from_github. Add/edit freely; the GUI re-reads this file on every Catalog mount.

v2 (2026-05-24): wshobson/agents repo reshuffled into a plugin marketplace layout (plugins/<plugin>/agents/<name>.md). Anthropic skills moved under skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Old paths now 404 — they are kept here with `dead: true` so the GUI can hide or warn rather than silently linking to a broken URL.

items.name: graphics-programmer
items.title: Graphics Programmer
items.summary: GLSL/HLSL/WGSL shaders + OpenGL/Vulkan/DX12/Metal/WebGPU rendering techniques (PBR, deferred, shadow maps, post-processing).
items.dead_reason: Path retired when wshobson/agents migrated to the plugins/<plugin>/agents/ layout in 2026-05. No direct replacement shipped yet.

items.name: shader-fundamentals
items.title: Shader Fundamentals
items.summary: Conceptual shader breakdowns and modern GPU programming patterns.
items.dead_reason: Not present in anthropics/skills (canonical Anthropic catalogue). Likely lives only in the user's local ecc plugin.
